metadata.title: FLOATING Pani Puri | GOBI Manchurian - STREET Fusion Food of Bangalore I Bangalore Food Tour
metadata.description:
Ladies and Gentlemen, pack your bags, book your tickets and come down to Bangalore for some amazing and delicious CHAAT !!

Chaat is a dish that is synonymous with North India, but wait till you have tried the Chaat in South. We tried a few versions of these sweet, tangy and spicy delights in Bangalore. The FLOATING PANI PURI, unlike the chaat we North Indians are usually used to, is mildly spiced but has a very soothing mouthfeel. We also tried a version of the humble Bhel, that is spiced with garlic and a lot of beautiful masalas.

But a trip down south can never be complete without tasting IDLI. THATTE IDLI is basically idlis that are as big as the plain and the one we had was so soft and flavorful that we can still taste it! This lovely steamed cake served with two scrumptious coconut chutneys was definitely a highlight of our trip. Along with this we tried a number of things that can only be found in Bangalore.

So if you're planning a holiday for this Christmas, just come down to Karnataka and if we may be so bold, do follow in our footsteps, our food choices will not disappoint you!

Sri Sai Chaat
Address - Beside A2B, 5th Block, Jayanagar, Bangalore, Karnataka
Price - Floating Pani Puri - INR 25 | NIPPAT MASALA - INR 30

Namma Brahmins Idli
Address - 8th B Main Road, 4th Block, Jayanagar, Bangalore, Karnataka
Price - Thatte Idli - INR 40

Raja Gobi
Address - 17th C Cross, Jayanagar, Bangalore, Karnataka
Price - Gobi Manchurian - INR 50

#FusionFood #WalkwithDelhiFoodWalks

About the host - Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
